description: Preview Word, WPS and OpenDocument files (.docx, .doc, .odt, .rtf) in VS Code, laid out by Wenshu (文枢), the open, Chinese-first office suite.
untrusted: Previews run the Wenshu command-line tool on the file; set its path only in trusted workspaces.
editor.name: Wenshu Preview (文枢)
config.cliPath: Path to the `wenshu` command-line tool. Empty: the installed Wenshu (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Wenshu\wenshu.exe`, `/usr/bin/wenshu`) or `wenshu` on `PATH`.
config.scale: Page image scale (1 = 96 dpi). Higher is sharper and slower.
